The first public build of Desiege: a launcher and runtime patch that makes Dungeon Siege run
well on modern Windows, without modifying any game files.

## What's in it

- **Native resolution, including widescreen and above 2048 px**, through the open-source
  [dxwrapper](https://github.com/elishacloud/dxwrapper) (downloaded on first launch, only with
  your consent).
- **UI scaling** (125 % – 200 %) with the 3D world still rendered at full native resolution.
- **Borderless fullscreen**, exclusive fullscreen or windowed.
- **Much higher frame rates**: roughly 35–45 fps → 160–180 fps in-game at 2560×1440 on the test
  machine, by removing GPU stalls in the cursor, the character shadows and dynamic vertex buffers.
- **GPU character shadows** with selectable quality (64 – 512 px).
- **Two launch methods**: inject (the game folder stays untouched) or a drop-in `ddraw.dll` so you
  can start the game from Steam.

See the [README](https://github.com/aegis-dev/desiege#readme) for details on every feature and
how it works.

## Installing

1. You need **your own copy of Dungeon Siege 1** (the Steam release is detected automatically).
2. Download `desiege-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` below and extract it anywhere. Keep the files
   together.
3. Run `desiege-launcher.exe`, accept the dxwrapper download, pick your settings and press
   **PLAY**.

The executables aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time you run
the launcher ("More info" → "Run anyway"). You can verify the download against the `.sha256`
file, or build it yourself from source.

## Known limitations

This is an early release, tested mainly on **Windows 11 + Steam release + NVIDIA GPU**.

- GOG and retail installs aren't auto-detected yet; enter the game folder manually.
- Legends of Aranna and multiplayer are untested.
- UI scale doesn't apply in windowed mode.
- AMD and Intel GPUs are untested; please report how it goes.

Bug reports are very welcome. Please attach `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Desiege\desiege.log`, your settings,
GPU and Windows version.

Desiege is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix, Microsoft or
Gas Powered Games. It contains no game files and requires a legally owned copy of the game.
